---
title: "G-GG — Generic group, global observable variant; bilinear types 1–3"
status: "Idealized Setup"
layer: 0
---

*G-GG* (Generic group, global observable variant; bilinear types 1–3) is part of *Layer 0: Idealized Setup and Resources* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: an idealized setup assumption or shared resource.

This functionality had no reference at all until a 2024 paper on the global, restricted-observable generic group model — it stands to the plain generic group exactly as *G-RO* stands to *F-RO*, and establishes UC security of a deployed zero-knowledge proof system without asymptotic overhead. Bilinear-group models are treated as folding into this functionality, since a bilinear group is a generic group with a pairing and the observable global functionality generalizes both.

*References:*

- Bobolz et al. [*The brave new world of global generic groups and UC-secure zero-overhead SNARKs*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2024/818). In 22nd Theory of Cryptography Conference (TCC), Part I, volume 15364 of LNCS, pages 90–124, 2024.
